verdict.rationale: React ships React Native for native mobile rendering and react-dom/react-dom/server for browser/server DOM, showing the component model can target non-browser-DOM platforms (react-docs-5, react-gh-2, react-comm-8), but the evidence pack never documents a public custom-renderer API (e.g. react-reconciler) or a guide for building a new host-config/custom renderer — this is entirely first-party 'use existing renderers' evidence, not 'write your own renderer' evidence. missing for 10: documentation or examples of the react-reconciler/custom host config API, first-party guidance on authoring a new renderer, and independent confirmation of custom-renderer usage beyond React Native/react-dom.
